ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_LOCATION_CCD
AS
BEGIN
-------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION
AS(
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY LocationId ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM (
SELECT * FROM (
	SELECT 
     CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CUST_ADDR1, CUST_ADDR2, CUST_ADDR3, CUST_ADDR4, CUST_ADD_CITY, CUST_ADD_PROVINCE, CUST_ADD_ZIPCODE)),1)  AS LocationId
    ,BCD.CUST_ADDR1 AS LocationAddressLine1
    ,BCD.CUST_ADDR2 AS LocationAddressLine2
    ,BCD.CUST_ADD_CITY AS LocationCity
    ,BCD.CUST_ADD_PROVINCE AS LocationStateId
    ,BCD.CUST_ADD_ZIPCODE AS LocationZipCode
    ,BCD.CUST_ADDR3 AS LocationAddressLine3
    ,BCD.CUST_ADDR4 AS LocationAddressLine4
	,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
	,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
	,BCD.BNK_CODE
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1

UNION

	SELECT 
     CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CUST_MADDR1, CUST_MADDR2, CUST_MADDR3, CUST_MADDR4, CUST_MADD_CITY, CUST_MADD_PROVINCE, CUST_MADD_ZIPCODE)),1)  AS LocationId
    ,BCD.CUST_MADDR1 AS LocationAddressLine1
    ,BCD.CUST_MADDR2 AS LocationAddressLine2
    ,BCD.CUST_MADD_CITY AS LocationCity
    ,BCD.CUST_MADD_PROVINCE AS LocationStateId
    ,BCD.CUST_MADD_ZIPCODE AS LocationZipCode
    ,BCD.CUST_MADDR3 AS LocationAddressLine3
    ,BCD.CUST_MADDR4 AS LocationAddressLine4
	,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
	,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
	,BCD.BNK_CODE
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1 
) MONTHLY  

UNION

SELECT * FROM (
	SELECT 
     CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CUST_ADDR1, CUST_ADDR2, CUST_ADDR3, CUST_ADDR4, CUST_ADD_CITY, CUST_ADD_PROVINCE, CUST_ADD_ZIPCODE)),1)  AS LocationId
    ,BCD.CUST_ADDR1 AS LocationAddressLine1
    ,BCD.CUST_ADDR2 AS LocationAddressLine2
    ,BCD.CUST_ADD_CITY AS LocationCity
    ,BCD.CUST_ADD_PROVINCE AS LocationStateId
    ,BCD.CUST_ADD_ZIPCODE AS LocationZipCode
    ,BCD.CUST_ADDR3 AS LocationAddressLine3
    ,BCD.CUST_ADDR4 AS LocationAddressLine4
	,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
	,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
	,BCD.BNK_CODE
 FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
 LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR  AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1

 UNION

	SELECT 
     CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CUST_MADDR1, CUST_MADDR2, CUST_MADDR3, CUST_MADDR4, CUST_MADD_CITY, CUST_MADD_PROVINCE, CUST_MADD_ZIPCODE)),1)  AS LocationId
    ,BCD.CUST_MADDR1 AS LocationAddressLine1
    ,BCD.CUST_MADDR2 AS LocationAddressLine2
    ,BCD.CUST_MADD_CITY AS LocationCity
    ,BCD.CUST_MADD_PROVINCE AS LocationStateId
    ,BCD.CUST_MADD_ZIPCODE AS LocationZipCode
    ,BCD.CUST_MADDR3 AS LocationAddressLine3
    ,BCD.CUST_MADDR4 AS LocationAddressLine4
	,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
	,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
	,BCD.BNK_CODE
 FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
 LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR  AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1

) DAILY
    ) A
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION FROM TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION WHERE RN = 1;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
LocationId
,LocationAddressLine1
,LocationAddressLine2
,LocationCity
,LocationStateId
,LocationZipCode
,LocationAddressLine3
,LocationAddressLine4
)) HASHROW, LocationId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
LocationId
,LocationAddressLine1
,LocationAddressLine2
,LocationCity
,LocationStateId
,LocationZipCode
,LocationAddressLine3
,LocationAddressLine4
)) HASHROW, LocationId
FROM BNKM.Location WHERE SOURCECODE = 'CCD'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.LocationId,TGT.LocationId) AS LocationId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.LocationId = TGT.LocationId

WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET

 LocationName = NULL 
,LocationDescription = NULL 
,LocationAddressLine1 = SRC.LocationAddressLine1
,LocationAddressLine2 = SRC.LocationAddressLine2
,LocationCity = SRC.LocationCity
,LocationStateId = SRC.LocationStateId
,LocationZipCode = SRC.LocationZipCode
,LocationNote = NULL
,LocationLatitude = NULL
,LocationLongitude = NULL
,LocationDatum = NULL
,LocationElevation = NULL
,LocationElevationUnitOfMeasureId = NULL
,GlobalLocationNumber = NULL
,TimezoneId = NULL
,DaylightSavingsTimeObservedIndicator = NULL
,CountryId = NULL
,SubdivisionId = NULL
,LocationAddressLine3 = SRC.LocationAddressLine3
,LocationAddressLine4 = SRC.LocationAddressLine4
,LocationHouseNumber = NULL
,LocationBuildingName = NULL
,LocationUnitNumber = NULL
,LocationStreet = NULL
,LocationBarangay = NULL

FROM BNKM.Location TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.LocationId = TGT.LocationId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION SRC ON SRC.LocationId = TGT.LocationId 



-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO  BNKM.Location  ( 
 LocationId
,LocationName
,LocationDescription
,LocationAddressLine1
,LocationAddressLine2
,LocationCity
,LocationStateId
,LocationZipCode
,LocationNote
,LocationLatitude
,LocationLongitude
,LocationDatum
,LocationElevation
,LocationElevationUnitOfMeasureId
,GlobalLocationNumber
,TimezoneId
,DaylightSavingsTimeObservedIndicator
,CountryId
,SubdivisionId
,LocationAddressLine3
,LocationAddressLine4
,LocationHouseNumber
,LocationBuildingName
,LocationUnitNumber
,LocationStreet
,LocationBarangay
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 LocationId AS LocationId
,NULL AS LocationName
,NULL AS LocationDescription
,LocationAddressLine1 AS LocationAddressLine1
,LocationAddressLine2 AS LocationAddressLine2
,LocationCity AS LocationCity
,LocationStateId AS LocationStateId
,LocationZipCode AS LocationZipCode
,NULL AS LocationNote
,NULL AS LocationLatitude
,NULL AS LocationLongitude
,NULL AS LocationDatum
,NULL AS LocationElevation
,NULL AS LocationElevationUnitOfMeasureId
,NULL AS GlobalLocationNumber
,NULL AS TimezoneId
,NULL AS DaylightSavingsTimeObservedIndicator
,NULL AS CountryId
,NULL AS SubdivisionId
,LocationAddressLine3 AS LocationAddressLine3
,LocationAddressLine4 AS LocationAddressLine4
,NULL AS LocationHouseNumber
,NULL AS LocationBuildingName
,NULL AS LocationUnitNumber
,NULL AS LocationStreet
,NULL AS LocationBarangay
,'CCD' AS SOURCECODE
,BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LOCATION
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


END
